name: @pipeworx/mcp-abgeordnetenwatch

tools.name: list_parliaments
tools.description: List German parliaments tracked by Abgeordnetenwatch: the federal Bundestag, all 16 state Landtage, and the EU parliament. Returns id, short name and full official name for each. Use the ids to scope politician or poll queries.

tools.name: search_politicians
tools.description: Search German federal and state politicians by name (surname or partial surname, contains-match). Returns matching politicians with party, year of birth and sex. Example: name "Scholz" or "Merz". Use get_politician with a returned id for the full profile.

name.description: Surname or partial surname to search for (contains match), e.g. "Scholz".

tools.name: get_politician
tools.description: Get the full profile of a single German politician by Abgeordnetenwatch id: name, party, year of birth, sex, education and residence. Get the id from search_politicians.

tools.name: list_polls
tools.description: List recorded parliamentary votes/polls (Abstimmungen) with their title and date. Optionally scope to a single legislative period via period_id (a parliament-period id). Returns most recent polls first.

period_id.description: Optional parliament-period (legislature) id to filter polls.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-abgeordnetenwatch forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the abgeordnetenwatch pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
